message.content: {"research_brief": "How did the HyperFund/HyperVerse alleged crypto-fraud network reportedly combine alleged Ponzi-like or crypto-investment mechanics, public promoters, organizational or brand rebranding, and the presentation of a questionable or disputed CEO persona to recruit and retain investors, and what evidence returned by the benchmark tools supports each part of that account? I want a complete, evidence-based investigation using only source IDs returned by the benchmark tools—without external sources, invented facts, or unsupported entity IDs and relationship names—and with every statement clearly labeled as an allegation, assessment, established fact, or uncertainty. The investigation should examine, where supported: (1) the alleged business and compensation mechanics, including investor deposits, promised or represented returns, referral/recruitment incentives, withdrawals, and any indications of Ponzi-like operation; (2) the roles, public statements, marketing activities, and promotion channels of public promoters or endorsers; (3) the sequence and significance of HyperFund, HyperVerse, and any other supported names or rebrands; (4) the identity, biography, credentials, public presentation, and disputed or questionable aspects of the purported CEO or leadership persona; (5) how these elements interacted to attract, persuade, and retain investors; and (6) contradictions, gaps, source limitations, and alternative interpretations. I have not specified a fixed date range, jurisdiction, source type beyond the benchmark tools, or required number of sources, so treat those dimensions as open-ended and use all relevant tool-returned evidence available, while noting temporal and evidentiary limits. Return a readable Markdown final report and a fenced JSON object containing exactly the arrays `findings`, `claims`, `reasoning_steps`, and `contradictions`; each finding must contain `question`, `answer`, `supporting_entities`, and `source_references`, each claim must contain `claim` and `source_references`, each reasoning step must contain `id`, `conclusion`, `premise_entities`, and `premise_relations`, and each contradiction must contain `contradiction_id`, `description`, and `source_references`. Do not ask whether to continue."}
